items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 104:1
items.html: (To the question) Because the Gevurot that are from the chest and above are of the degree of ZA himself, and they are fit to be received from Aba and Ima themselves, who are considered their upper one; therefore she receives them immediately, with her ascent as MAN, and they are sawed apart. But from the chest and below are the Gevurot belonging to Rachel, who is considered the third degree from Aba and Ima, and she is obligated to receive the Gevurot a second time, by means of ZA in his place, who is her upper one. Therefore, from the Keter of ZA to his chest, they are sawed apart in all their completeness, on the first day of Rosh Hashanah; but the Gevurot from the chest and below begin to be sawed apart on the first day, after the shofar blast, by her receiving then from ZA; and so they go and are sawed apart during the Ten Days of Repentance, until they are completed on Yom Kippur. (Item 124).
